Outcome

Certify the first relational slice against independent and adversarial courts.

Acceptance

- Pair reversal transposes the form; direct query equals materialize-then-contract.
- Partition permutation, effect reorder, feature reorder, and measurement composition laws pass.
- Independent orthogonal partitions give the expected zero while overlapping estimates expose known bias.
- Noise precision convention matches an independent oracle.
- Dense/operator paths and exact work receipts agree on JVM and Scala.js.
set.title: P4B.7: establish relational adjoint, pairing, oracle, leakage, and work courts
